questions.stem: What is the main chemical reaction involved in the production of soap?
questions.explanation: The production of soap involves saponification, where fats react with an alkali to produce soap and glycerol. Neutralization and hydrolysis are different types of reactions, while polymerization involves forming polymers.

distractorRationale.a: Neutralization involves acid-base reactions, not the formation of soap.
distractorRationale.c: Hydrolysis is the breakdown of compounds with water, not the main reaction in soap making.
distractorRationale.d: Polymerization involves forming large molecules from small units, not soap production.
